stem: The tenure of the Congress ministries formed in the elections of 1937 after the Act of 1935 was:
expl: The tenure of the Congress ministries formed in the elections of 1936-37 A.D. under the Act of 1935 was 28 months. Congress ministries resigned from legislature on 22nd October 1939 A.D. (although the government of Assam and NWFP was resigned later) because Indians were included in the Second World War without the consultation with Indian leaders. Jinnah called All India Muslim League to celebrate 22nd December 1939 A.D. (Friday) as Day of Deliverance due to the resignation of Congress ministries.

stem: The elected Government of Bihar formed by Shri Krishna Singh resigned in February 1938 for which reason?

options.label: a
options.text: Satyagraha against the British at the call of Gandhiji

options.label: b
options.text: Participation in the Freedom Struggle of India

options.label: c
options.text: For the release of political prisoners

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: In 1937, when the Congress came to power in Bihar, Shri Krishna Singh became the province's Premier. He formed his cabinet in Patna on 20 July 1937 A.D. under Government of India Act 1935. However his ministry resigned in 1938 AD to put pressure on the Governor for the release of political prisoners. Governor later conceded to the demands and ministry resumed offi ces but in October 1939 A.D., his ministry again resigned on the issue of India's participation in World War-II.

stem: In which working Committee did the Congress adopt the policy of abolishing land ownership?
expl: The Congress Working Committee adopted the policy of abolishing feudal intermediaries/peasants proprietorship in 1937 A.D. The tenancy bill was passed by the Congress government in United Province and Bihar. Each Congress-governed province attempted to improve irrigation facilities and to save farmers from cruel policies of money lenders.

stem: Who of the following was entrusted with finance portfolio in the ministry formed in U.P. after the election of 1937?
expl: Congress won 134 seats out of 228 seats in United Provinces Provincial Assembly election held in 1936-37 A.D. Congress formed government independently in United Province. Prime Minister (Premier) was Govind Ballabh Pant and Kailash Nath Katju was Law and Justice Minister in the government while the Finance Department was given to Rafi Ahmed Kidwai.

expl: Sir James David Sifton was Governor of Bihar and Orissa when Bihar was separated from it and established as separate state in 1936 A.D. by Government of India Act of 1935.
